scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter @tectonic/api prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter @tectonic/api prisma:generate
scripts.dev: pnpm db:setup && pnpm --filter @tectonic/sdk build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "pnpm --filter @tectonic/api dev" "pnpm --filter @tectonic/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tectonic/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @tectonic/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @tectonic/web typecheck
